evidence_semantics: A deployment receipt proves deployment occurred; it does not by itself prove production behavior. Production claims require production evidence.
parity_rule: If production parity fails, investigate the actual request and runtime contract; do not weaken acceptance gates to obtain a green result.
purpose: The deployment doctrine of the activation kit: deployment as a boundary rather than proof, the deployment order, and evidence semantics.
rule: Deployment is a boundary, not proof.
title: OPERATIONS / DEPLOYMENT
